memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel. You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the Lord, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by chasing after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.'" — Num 15:37-39 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
After the solemn warnings about sin, God gives a gracious, practical help: tassels on their garments. Every day, as an Israelite dressed and moved about, these tassels would catch their eye and remind them of God's commands. It was a simple, tangible aid against forgetfulness.

How well God knows us. He understands that we are forgetful creatures, prone to drift. We do not usually fall into sin through one dramatic decision, but through slowly forgetting God as the pull of "our own hearts and eyes" quietly leads us astray. So God gave a visible reminder woven into everyday life, to call His people back to Him again and again.

We too need reminders. Left to ourselves, we forget God's word and wander after whatever our eyes desire. The tassels teach us the wisdom of building reminders of God into the rhythm of our days — a verse on the wall, a habit of prayer, a note in our pocket, a moment of pause before we act. These small helps keep God before our eyes when the world constantly competes for our attention.

The deeper point is the danger of a wandering heart and the mercy of a God who helps us stay faithful. And we have a greater help than tassels: the Holy Spirit living within us, who brings God's word to our remembrance and works in us to obey. Where the tassels could only remind from the outside, the Spirit writes God's law on our hearts from within. Ask Him to keep God ever before your eyes today.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What reminders of God have you built into your daily life?
2. How does forgetting God slowly lead the heart astray?
3. How does the Holy Spirit help you remember and obey God's word?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You know how forgetful I am and how easily my heart wanders. Help me to build reminders of You into my days, and thank You for Your Spirit who writes Your word on my heart and calls me back to You. Amen.
